node.statement: For any such same-datum packet, lem-routef-k-finiteness identifies rho_fac as a common domain for the three factorization estimates. Combining the root assumption 0 <= eta <= eta_K with 1.1.1 gives 0 <= eta <= rho_DeltaUpsilon, 0 <= eta <= rho_mult, and 0 <= eta <= rho_UpsilonDelta, while 1.1.2 gives every serial supply hypothesis required by lem-routef-delta-upsilon-telescope, lem-routef-multiplicative-telescope, and lem-routef-upsilon-delta-telescope.
